meta.promptText: Which sarees should I buy online in India for a wedding on a budget?

response.text:
For a wedding in India on a budget, I’d recommend a saree that looks rich in photographs, has a beautiful border or pallu, and can be worn again for festivals and family functions. You don’t need to spend ₹10,000 or more to get a lovely wedding look.

**My sweet spot is ₹1,500–₹3,500**, with options below ₹1,000 if you’re shopping on a tighter budget. Current online listings include Banarasi-style silk blends, Bandhani sarees, embroidered georgette, and organza designs at these price points. [www.myntra.com](https://www.myntra.com/wedding-sarees-below-5000)[www.myntra.com](https://www.myntra.com/saree-under-5000)[www.flipkart.com](https://www.flipkart.com/q/pattu-sarees-below-5000)

## Best types of budget wedding sarees

        The Weavers Shop by Raavi](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/qbnAatOrS1A3XeN-oqr6O0aeUoJHmSG7zPlzy6oae9TXGdtBXCNCNm2j6AOPtJ2MIMeEi96N3mT_9IkxUB3qH64yhXTBNmOu7NWc7bK4mM68y2KxwHBcixd_zHVY8845QJAiSyD578Z5tpzvMogbMt8FI8p7sqK2eqWLhsnX7tnhTDocK5ZCQQlvoRsMy1Yt?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Banarasi-style silk blend**

Budget: ₹1,000–₹3,500

Best for traditional weddings, poojas and family ceremonies. Choose maroon, wine, emerald green or royal blue with gold-toned zari.

Shop: [Myntra](https://www.myntra.com/wedding-sarees-below-5000) · [Flipkart](https://www.flipkart.com/q/pattu-sarees-below-5000)

---

![KcPc New HO silk Bandhani Style With Gotapatti Work Saree ASH](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/TtZ_BA4zznbRI6w9IHaKSfiwgr76xXBmeYKN-sbwTWtMhxujyciKbP-E44G935p8fLWcyOVqlKCq6daWhYhl-O4axJ2Ji0J1fBAs1Eo3D5y22_isXFhNF5oWyPrFtN2GC1FG62mblhcgHFIXri60-DIGZUKPkslrvsb-ASGQSxhGcSXYRQuOBqOBaCrbu-if?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bandhani saree**

Budget: ₹800–₹2,500

A beautiful choice for Gujarati weddings, garba, mehendi and haldi. Look for rani pink, red, mustard or green with a contrasting border.

Shop: [Myntra sarees](https://www.myntra.com/saree-under-5000) · [LimeRoad](https://www.limeroad.com/shalu-sarees-for-wedding-latest-under-5000)

**3\. Embroidered organza saree**

Budget: ₹1,500–₹3,500

Ideal for daytime weddings and engagement ceremonies. Peach, lavender, powder blue and sage green look elegant with delicate embroidery.

Shop: [Browse wedding sarees](https://www.myntra.com/wedding-sarees-below-5000) · [Prashanti Sarees](https://prashantisarees.com/)

– Monamaar](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/IAbKFnOR25fh0YdWHTiFX56pvIIXrcHS8ybS6vF0bHYqc0YT3Qswa9DgMVymSX6zbivgRci1FkRyPKCtRwWUMBSGk_1yT1LocGfN_PL0ooycSdMLpms8AtenrlxkPPlqwj0FiRXiMhgvov1LRLGwBxW0do5OfpEFWNiS9N659YYlu5NptWk56-Udt3ogAucL?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Sequin or embroidered georgette**

Budget: ₹900–₹2,500

Great for a reception or evening wedding. Choose navy, black, wine or emerald with subtle shimmer for a dressier look.

Shop: [Myntra sarees](https://www.myntra.com/saree-under-5000) · [Flipkart](https://www.flipkart.com/)

---

![Pure handloom silk saree – SUBHAM GRAND](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/-bjUUpPWAZ6tzzoJbAE8mNBj85IJnXCOqC4A3zqjxLP0xri5ePt0ps_KhAGyRv0raDJ7NLOfVCtNvoN-1Vj9m_VQDWIAKaI5Kx0Iwed4f4dle8tKkP7J5CJO8nkDytXRLJtkusySnQJeELsv9H1wrm54FJN1uY41ICi2gG8HdT4DNBd9NCNFAjmMcjsg5vkv?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Kanjivaram-style silk blend**

Budget: ₹1,000–₹3,000

For a classic South Indian-inspired look. Look for purple, magenta, bottle green or teal with a contrasting gold border.

Shop: [Myntra](https://www.myntra.com/wedding-sarees-below-5000) · [Flipkart](https://www.flipkart.com/q/pattu-sarees-below-5000)

## What I would buy at each budget

| Your budget | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Under ₹1,000 | Simple Bandhani or woven silk-blend saree |
| ₹1,000–₹2,000 | Banarasi-style saree with a rich border |
| ₹2,000–₹3,500 | Embroidered organza or a better-finished silk blend |
| ₹3,500–₹5,000 | Premium lightweight Banarasi or a more detailed festive saree |


These are shopping targets rather than guaranteed current prices. For example, Myntra currently has a broad wedding-saree selection under ₹5,000. [www.myntra.com](https://www.myntra.com/wedding-sarees-below-5000)[thepanaya.com](https://thepanaya.com/blogs/the-panaya/best-banarasi-sarees-under-rs-5000)

### Before you order online

- Check whether the fabric is pure silk, art silk, polyester or a blend. Don't assume a low-priced saree is genuine silk.
- Confirm whether an unstitched blouse piece is included.
- Read customer reviews with real photos and check the return policy.
- Compare the actual selling price, not just the advertised discount.
- Leave some budget for blouse stitching, accessories and footwear.
